data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 4/6, ex-finding 7): Add rollback/idempotency for usage.json on dispatcher exception. If litellm.completion succeeds + usage written but _parse_response raises, usage entry remains while review record is absent — cost-attribution leak. Add try/except around dispatch_review main path: on uncaught exception, write usage entry with additional 'review_outcome': 'failed' + exception class/message. RED test: monkeypatch _parse_response to raise; assert usage.json entry exists with review_outcome=failed.
